Are there any unposted journals for period of 23-Dec?
SELECT journal_name, creation_date, created_by, journal_category, ledger_name, period_name, period_status FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS WHERE PERIOD_NAME='Dec-23' AND PERIOD_STATUS='U'
Can you give me the list of unposted JVs (Journal Vouchers) in February - 23?
SELECT journal_name, creation_date, created_by, journal_category, ledger_name, period_name, period_status FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS WHERE PERIOD_NAME='Feb-23' AND PERIOD_STATUS='U'
Show me how many posted and unposted journals are there for the period of Dec-23
SELECT period_status, COUNT(*) AS journal_count FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS WHERE period_name = 'Dec-23' GROUP BY period_status
Can you show me the list of unposted JEs (Journal Entries) in April -23?
SELECT journal_name, creation_date, created_by, journal_category, ledger_name, period_name, period_status FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS WHERE PERIOD_NAME='Apr-23' AND PERIOD_STATUS='U'
give me list of posted jouranls in period January 2023
SELECT journal_name, creation_date, created_by, journal_category, ledger_name, period_name, period_status FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS WHERE period_name='Jan-24' AND period_status='P'
Has anyone forgotten to post the jouranls in April -23? Can you show me the list?
SELECT journal_name, creation_date, created_by, journal_category, ledger_name, period_name, period_status FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS WHERE PERIOD_NAME='Apr-23' AND PERIOD_STATUS='U';
How many journals are there for each category?
SELECT journal_category, COUNT(*) AS journal_count FROM JOURNAL_DETAILS GROUP BY journal_category
